my-privacy-agent.note: My Privacy Agent public MCP server (Streamable HTTP). No account, key, or sign-in. The five tools are read-only and return only information already published on myprivacyagent.com: verified opt-out guides, the documented removal route for 950+ people-search and data-broker sites, and privacy library search. They never look a person up. Account tools (your own report and case status) are not part of this version; the person runs their private check on the website.
